title: Observable Quantity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must identify the angular distribution related to the decay of e^+ as the observable quantity.

title: Angular Distribution Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct formula for the angular distribution of e^+ produced in the muon decay.

title: Parity Violation Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain that both decay processes violate parity conservation due to weak interactions.

title: Correctness of Distribution
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive or state the form of the angular distribution and its implications for parity.

title: Units and Dimensions
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include appropriate units for the angular distribution or mention dimensionless nature.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as misidentifying the decay processes or incorrectly stating the angular distribution.
